text: Whichever path is taken, sea level is committed to rise for centuries to millennia.

text: Worldwide, about 110 million people live on land below the current high-tide line.
About 190 million people live today on land that would lie below the projected high-tide line by 2100 under RCP2.6 (90% range 150–250 million).
About 200 million people live today on land that would lie below the projected high-tide line by 2100 under RCP4.5 (90% range 160–260 million).
About 230 million people live today on land that would lie below the projected high-tide line by 2100 under RCP8.5 (90% range 180–310 million).
CO2 emissions decline to net zero around or after 2050, followed by varying levels of net negative CO2 emissions.
